rules.requirement: Construction documents must be signed and sealed by a Puerto Rico licensed professional engineer or architect.
rules.check_hint: Check title blocks for CIAPR seal and signature.

rules.requirement: Submit the complete architectural drawing set matching the drawing index.
rules.check_hint: Check index sheets against submitted drawings.

rules.requirement: Large fixed glazing in the windborne-debris region requires impact protection.
rules.check_hint: Verify windborne-debris protection details/shutters in coastal zones.

rules.requirement: Specify the seismic design category (SDC) based on Ss/S1 and soil class.
rules.check_hint: Verify structural notes for site coordinates, Ss, S1, and SDC.

rules.requirement: State the ultimate design wind speed (145-170 mph for Puerto Rico).
rules.check_hint: Check design parameters in structural notes.

rules.requirement: All exposed structural members and connections must be corrosion-resistant.
rules.check_hint: Check structural connection details for exposure classification.

rules.requirement: Energy compliance must be modeled for Climate Zone 1A (hot-humid).
rules.check_hint: Verify insulation, SHGC values, and climate zone selection.

rules.requirement: Provide FEMA flood zone determination and base flood elevation (BFE) for coastal parcels.
rules.check_hint: Check site/civil plan for flood zone information.
